newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares close higher, little movement seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares close higher, little movement seen.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Tuesday in a low turnover market, with dealers seeing a period of consolidation ahead with current levels holding.

"I think we are going to see a few days of consolidation before anything much happens. The market is stable after the past few days' rises. The United States will determine which way we move tomorrow," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 1.10 point higher at 165.94 in overall bourse turnover of 908 million crowns. The KFX June future fell 0.35 point to 165.70 with 325 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Carlsberg was in the limelight announcing a better than expected 870 million crown first-half 1996/97 pre-tax profit, up 17.4 percent on the same period last year, but its share finished seven crowns down at 388.

On their first day of trading on the exchange shares in Danish aviation spares distributor Satair - outside the KFX index - finished at 200 crowns after opening at 205, 21 percent above its initial offer price of 171 crowns.
